# Extra GitHub tools for Colour Diam ads

These open-source repos improve beat-synced branding video and conversion content.

## Installed in this repo

1. [Meteor8/beats-synced-video-generator](https://github.com/Meteor8/beats-synced-video-generator)
   Beat tracking with librosa. Used by `generator/beats.py`.
2. [remotion-dev/template-helloworld](https://github.com/remotion-dev/template-helloworld)
   Motion-graphics template for future HTML/React ad overlays.

## Recommended next installs

- [Jellevanderwerff/thebeat](https://github.com/Jellevanderwerff/thebeat) — rhythm science helpers
- [Zulko/moviepy](https://github.com/Zulko/moviepy) — clip assembly
- [librosa/librosa](https://github.com/librosa/librosa) — audio analysis already in requirements

Keep every Colour Diam film focused on register, shop, or enquire.
